consequences: Keep F23-F25 partial, require rebuilt matching sidecar, Rust1.89, notification AUMID installation verification and native isolated deletion/export acceptance; historical installer evidence cannot certify this source batch.
context: F23-F25 implementation now spans Host space catalog, WinRT notification preferences and a backend-only offline erasure helper; documentation had not captured implementation versus installed boundaries.
decision: Trusted Host owns identity-derived paths, CAS/atomic catalog and confirmed graceful space restart; managed spaces cannot silently import legacy secrets. Notification preferences remain scoped, default off and content-free; OS acceptance is not delivery. Offline erasure requires stopped identity, exact confirmation and owner-scoped vault/registry operations; it remains unavailable as a client flow until Host/UI/receipt/export integration and isolated acceptance complete.
title: Host-owned desktop spaces and bounded native privacy settings
